reskinNotes: All colors are baked into inline style={{}} hex/rgba (nav pill #0C0C0C, hamburger-open #1a1a1a, panel rgba(8,8,8,0.97), white-alpha tints and borders) rather than Tailwind tokens; font-family is hardcoded per-element inline (Inter on most, Courier New on the subhead); icon stroke color is hardcoded color="white"; all copy is hardcoded in markup with nav labels in a NAV_ITEMS array; the unused @supabase/supabase-js dependency is presentational-only and irrelevant to reskinning.
